title: Matching with Learning: A Bayesian Assignment Game Approach
title_primary: Matching with Learning: A Bayesian Assignment Game Approach
authors: Saeed Najafi-Zangeneh, Olivier Gossner
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study two-sided matching with transferable utility in which each match generates a surplus composed of a commonly known observable component and an initially unknown idiosyncratic component. The idiosyncratic component is revealed gradually through a sequence of publicly observed signals, one per worker firm pair per period. The paper examines a benchmark in which signals are produced externally and are observed regardless of the realized matching. This benchmark is motivated by markets with verifiable and portable evaluation such as standardized tests, certifications, platform ratings, and publication records. Under risk neutrality and common posteriors, each date’s market reduces to a standard Shapley-Shubik assignment game on posterior expected surpluses, and stability is defined as membership in the core of that game. We provide closed-form Normal-Normal Bayesian updating, proving existence of core outcomes at every date, and derive comparative statics in signal precision and in the strength of industry specific comparative advantage. The main long run result is that, under a unique efficient matching margin condition, the matching that maximizes posterior expected total surplus coincides with the efficient matching after a finite random time almost surely, and the probability of selecting an inefficient matching at date t admits an explicit exponential upper bound. Simulations illustrate how information accumulation generates early turnover and how industry specific comparative advantage reshapes the decomposition of worker payoff dispersion into within- and between-industry components. This framework gives a clear starting point to study more complex situations where information comes from actual matches or is kept private.

abstract: This paper investigates the adoption of short-time work by firms and their participating employees. We present a model showing that short-time work can preserve jobs in firms facing severe negative revenue shocks, but not in less affected firms, where hours are reduced without preventing layoffs. Using data from all French establishments during the 2008-2009 Great Recession, we find that short-time work helped save jobs and increased hours worked in firms hit by significant revenue losses, facilitating a faster post-recession recovery. We also identify substantial windfall effects, which raise the policy’s cost per job saved. Nonetheless, short-time work is likely more cost-effective at preserving employment than wage subsidies, potentially resulting in a net negative cost to public finances.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了企业及其参与员工采用短时工作制的情况。我们提出一个模型，表明短时工作制能在面临严重负面收入冲击的企业中保住工作岗位，但在受影响较小的企业中则不然，这些企业虽减少了工时却未能避免裁员。利用2008-2009年大衰退期间法国所有机构的数据，我们发现，短时工作制帮助遭受重大收入损失的企业保住了工作并增加了工作时间，促进了衰退后更快的复苏。我们还识别出显著的意外收益效应，这提高了该政策每保住一个工作岗位的成本。尽管如此，短时工作制在维持就业方面可能比工资补贴更具成本效益，并可能对公共财政产生净负成本。

authors: Eduardo Fraga

abstract: Why are populations more spatially concentrated in some countries than in others? And why does that concentration change over time? I study how international trade integration affects the within-country spatial allocation of population and the welfare implications of these reallocations. A one-sector quantitative spatial model isolates a key mechanism: lower international trade costs disproportionately benefit regions with high foreign import dependence, which tend to be less populated regions within their countries. For greater realism, I then estimate a two-sector extension with non-homothetic preferences, allowing sectoral composition to adjust endogenously while retaining regional differences in trade access and local fundamentals. Counterfactuals imply that external integration reduces spatial concentration on average, raises aggregate welfare, and modestly tilts within-country welfare gains toward peripheral regions. In a decomposition of 1990–2005 concentration changes, trade-cost and productivity changes account for a modest share of cross-country variation, while inferred amenity changes capture most of the remainder.
abstract_zh: 为什么有些国家的人口在空间上比其他国家更为集中？为什么这种集中程度会随时间变化？我研究国际贸易一体化如何影响国家内部人口的空间分布，以及这些重新配置对福利的影响。一个单部门定量空间模型揭示了关键机制：较低的国际贸易成本不成比例地惠及那些对外国进口依赖度高的地区，而这些地区往往是其国内人口较少的区域。为增强现实性，我随后估计了一个具有非齐次偏好的两部门扩展模型，允许部门结构内生调整，同时保留区域间贸易准入和地方基本条件的差异。反事实分析表明，外部一体化平均降低了空间集中度，提高了总体福利，并适度地将国内福利收益向边缘地区倾斜。在对1990年至2005年集中度变化的分解中，贸易成本和生产率的变动解释了跨国差异的适度份额，而推断的便利性变化则解释了其余大部分差异。

authors: Ferran Elias, Henry Redondo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies how reducing the cost differential between permanent and temporary contracts affects firms’ use of each contract type. We analyze a 1997 Spanish reform that lowered non-wage labor costs for new open-ended (OE) contracts for workers under 30 and over 45, while leaving short-term (ST) contracts unaffected. Exploiting sectoral exposure and age-based discontinuities, we show that firms substitute strongly from ST to OE contracts for young workers but respond little for older workers. We find partial wage incidence of the subsidy on directly affected permanent jobs. The implied elasticity of substitution between ST and OE contracts is 6.5 for workers below age 30 and close to zero for workers above age 45. We also document that young workers’ wages rise in unsubsidized ST jobs consistent with the expansion of OE employment strengthening their outside options. Overall, the results reveal sharp age asymmetries in contract substitution. They suggest that monetary incentives can facilitate transitions from temporary to permanent employment for young workers, but are less effective for workers above age 45.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了降低永久合同与临时合同之间的成本差异如何影响企业对各类合同的使用。我们分析了1997年西班牙的一项改革，该改革降低了30岁以下及45岁以上新签无固定期限（OE）合同的非工资劳动力成本，而短期（ST）合同则未受影响。利用行业暴露程度和基于年龄的断点，我们表明，对于年轻工人，企业会显著从ST合同转向OE合同，但对年长工人的反应则较小。我们发现补贴对直接受影响的永久性工作岗位存在部分工资传导效应。对于30岁以下的工人，ST与OE合同之间的替代弹性估计为6.5，而对于45岁以上的工人，该弹性接近于零。我们还记录了年轻工人在未获补贴的ST岗位中工资上升的现象，这与OE就业扩张增强了他们的外部选择权相一致。总体而言，研究结果揭示了合同替代中显著的年龄不对称性。这表明，货币激励可以促进年轻工人从临时就业转向永久就业，但对于45岁以上的工人效果则较为有限。

title: An autopsy of the voluntary carbon market

authors: Ugo Panizza, Francesco Tripoli, Beatrice Weder di Mauro
official: 官方在线 2026-08-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The voluntary carbon market was built on a single promise: that one credit cancels one tonne. Most scrutiny has asked whether that promise holds on the supply side – whether the credits are real. This column asks a different question: what did the mere availability of offsets do to the firms that bought them? Using a buyer-linked dataset spanning the near-universe of offset retirements, and the 2023 integrity scandals as a natural experiment, the authors find that firms which walked away from offsetting cut their own operational emissions sharply more than firms that stayed. Even a market of flawless credits could still slow real decarbonisation.
abstract_zh: 自愿性碳市场建立在一个单一承诺之上：一单位碳信用抵消一吨排放。多数审查关注的是这一承诺在供应端是否成立——即碳信用是否真实。本文提出一个不同的问题：仅仅是抵消机制的可获得性，对购买这些碳信用的企业产生了何种影响？利用覆盖近乎全部碳信用注销的买方关联数据集，并以2023年诚信丑闻作为自然实验，作者发现，放弃抵消的企业其自身运营排放的削减幅度显著大于继续参与抵消的企业。即便碳信用市场完美无瑕，仍可能延缓实际的脱碳进程。

abstract: Anti-immigration policies often rest on the premise that immigrants worsen native-born employment and wages. This column uses data from 2000 to 2023 to estimate the impact of immigration to the US on national wages and employment, focusing on national rather than local impacts. The authors find that in these two decades, net immigration to the US was heavily college-intensive and raised the wages of less-educated natives. It also increased natives’ employment. Natives’ reallocation into higher-paying, communication-intensive occupations, complementary to those filled by immigrants, is one mechanism behind these gains.
abstract_zh: 反移民政策往往基于一个前提，即移民会恶化本土出生者的就业和工资状况。本文利用2000年至2023年的数据，评估了美国移民对全国工资和就业的影响，重点关注全国层面而非地方层面的效应。作者发现，在这二十年里，美国净移民高度集中于受过大学教育的人群，并提升了教育程度较低的本土出生者的工资水平。同时，移民也增加了本土出生者的就业机会。本土出生者向薪酬更高、沟通密集型职业的重新配置，与移民所从事的职业形成互补，是这些收益背后的机制之一。

abstract: The slow adoption of wagon transport in the Andes is a puzzle. We examine it by developing a threshold technology-adoption model calibrated using human and mule energy consumption and unique historical data from a human trail and the first wagon road in the Andes. Model predictions align with historical social choices. Pre-Columbians selected a straight, steep, short route for human porters to reduce energy costs, while the Spanish used it with mule packs. Late nineteenth-century transport demand growth surpassed the model’s threshold and contributed to construction of the zigzagging, gentle, long wagon road route, as well as incentives to build state capacity.
abstract_zh: 安第斯地区马车运输的缓慢采用是一个谜团。我们通过构建一个阈值技术采纳模型来探究此问题，该模型利用人力和骡马能量消耗数据以及来自安第斯地区一条人行小道和首条马车道路的独特历史数据进行校准。模型预测与历史上的社会选择相吻合。前哥伦布时期的人们选择了一条笔直、陡峭且路程较短的人行路线，以降低人力搬运者的能量成本，而西班牙人则利用此路线进行骡马驮运。19世纪末，运输需求的增长超过了模型的阈值，这不仅促进了蜿蜒平缓的长距离马车道路的建设，也激发了构建国家能力的动力。

title: The Confucian Fertility Paradox: Education Competition and Ultra-Low Fertility in East Asia
title_zh: 儒家生育悖论：教育竞争与东亚超低生育率
title_primary: 儒家生育悖论：教育竞争与东亚超低生育率
title_secondary: The Confucian Fertility Paradox: Education Competition and Ultra-Low Fertility in East Asia
authors: Hanming Fang, Chang Liu
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Total fertility rates in East Asia have fallen to levels without historical precedent, even though the region’s Confucian heritage long placed extraordinary emphasis on family continuity and large families. We argue that this “Confucian Fertility Paradox” dissolves once we separate two strands of the tradition and recognize that modernization affected them very differently. The pro-natal strand, built on lineage continuity, ancestor worship, and reliance on sons for old-age support, was gradually switched off as child mortality fell, incomes rose, women entered the labor force, and state pensions replaced the family as the main source of security in old age. What survived was the second strand: the veneration of education and of status won through examination success, rooted in the imperial examination tradition. Under modern conditions this surviving strand reverses sign with respect to its effect on fertility. Where the historical examination system rewarded having many sons so that one might succeed, the modern single-ranking tournament rewards concentrating resources on one or two intensively educated children, and the quantity–quality tradeoff turns a once pro-natal culture into a powerful engine of low fertility. Drawing on recent empirical evidence from China and Korea, we show how education competition becomes the channel through which traditional values now suppress childbearing. We explain why standard pro-natalist policies, such as removing birth restrictions or offering cash subsidies, accomplish little when the underlying problem is a competitive equilibrium in parental investment, and we argue that policies aimed at the source of the distortion, such as structural reform of educational pathways, hold more promise.
abstract_zh: 东亚地区的总和生育率已降至史无前例的低水平，尽管该地区悠久的儒家传统历来极度重视家族延续与多子多福。本文认为，一旦我们将这一传统中的两条脉络加以区分，并认识到现代化对它们产生了截然不同的影响，所谓的"儒家生育悖论"便迎刃而解。第一条鼓励生育的脉络——建立在宗族延续、祖先崇拜以及养儿防老基础之上——随着儿童死亡率下降、收入增长、女性进入劳动力市场以及国家养老金取代家庭成为老年保障的主要来源而逐渐消退。留存下来的是第二条脉络：对教育的尊崇以及通过科举成功获得社会地位的追求，这一传统根植于帝国科举制度。在现代条件下，这条留存下来的脉络对生育的影响发生了逆转。历史上的科举制度奖励多生儿子以增加中举概率，而现代单一排名的锦标赛式竞争则鼓励将资源集中投入于一两个接受精英教育的子女身上。数量与质量的权衡使曾经鼓励生育的文化转变为低生育率的强大引擎。基于来自中国和韩国的最新实证证据，我们揭示了教育竞争如何成为传统价值观抑制生育的传导渠道。我们解释了为何当根本问题在于父母投资中的竞争均衡时，诸如取消生育限制或提供现金补贴等标准鼓励生育政策收效甚微，并论证了针对扭曲根源的政策——例如教育路径的结构性改革——更具前景。

abstract: Does central bank independence shape the inflationary impact of geopolitical risk? Using a panel of 29 countries over 1990–2023, we show that geopolitical risk significantly increases inflation, but that this effect depends on the degree of central bank independence. Higher institutional credibility substantially attenuates, and in some case offsets, the inflationary impact of geopolitical shocks. This moderating effect is stronger for geopolitical threats than for realized actions and is considerably more pronounced in advanced than in emerging economies. These findings highlight the importance of credible monetary institutions in enhancing resilience to geopolitical inflation.

authors: Kalle Hirvonen, Daniel O. Gilligan, Jessica Leight, Heleene Tambet, Victor Villa

abstract: We assess whether layering an ultra-poor graduation program on Ethiopia’s Productive Safety Net Programme (PSNP) protects women and their households from localized weather shocks. Using panel data from a large cluster-randomized trial matched with detailed weather records, we identify community-level exposure to dryness shocks. Women who are exposed to dryness shocks experience deteriorating nutritional status (in conjunction with declining household food security and assets) and a significant increase in the risk of intimate partner violence. However, access to the graduation program fully buffers women from any increase in intimate partner violence, and partially buffers women and their households against other adverse effects. Further analysis suggests that improved household savings likely drives the program’s protective impact.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了在埃塞俄比亚生产性安全网计划（PSNP）基础上叠加极端贫困毕业计划，是否能够保护女性及其家庭免受局部天气冲击的影响。利用大规模整群随机试验的面板数据，结合详细的天气记录，我们识别了社区层面的干旱冲击暴露程度。遭受干旱冲击的女性营养状况恶化（同时伴随家庭粮食安全与资产下降），且亲密伴侣暴力风险显著上升。然而，参与毕业计划完全缓冲了女性亲密伴侣暴力的增加，并部分缓解了女性及其家庭面临的其他不利影响。进一步分析表明，家庭储蓄改善很可能是该计划保护效应的驱动因素。

abstract: This paper studies the factors determining plant size and interplant output allocation within the boundaries of a multiplant firm under conditions of demand uncertainty. It shows that asymmetric information between headquarters and individual plants is one factor determining plant size and output allocation: since the existence of excess capacity creates ?high powered? incentives for individual plants, capacity levels in a second-best setting exceed the corresponding benchmark in a first-best world if capacity prices are low. The presence of ?agency costs? in the case of fully-utilized capacity reverses this result for high-capacity prices. Also, in a recession output is not necessarily assigned to the plant with the lowest production costs.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在需求不确定条件下，决定多工厂企业边界内工厂规模及厂际产出分配的因素。研究表明，总部与各工厂之间的信息不对称是决定工厂规模与产出分配的关键因素之一：由于过剩产能的存在为单个工厂提供了“强激励”，当产能价格较低时，次优环境下的产能水平会超过最优基准下的对应水平。而在产能充分利用的情况下，“代理成本”的存在则会在高产能价格时逆转这一结果。此外，在经济衰退期，产出并不必然分配给生产成本最低的工厂。

abstract: This paper develops an information design model to analyze how underwriters strategically disclose firm-specific information prior to equity issuance. The model predicts the existence of discriminatory disclosure: for high-quality firms, the disclosed offering price is positively correlated with firm fundamentals, whereas for low-quality firms, this correlation breaks down. Empirical evidence from China’s stock market under a market-oriented registration system supports this theoretical prediction, based on a proprietary dataset of IPO valuations sourced exclusively from underwriters’ internal pricing reports.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个信息设计模型，分析承销商在股权发行前如何策略性地披露企业特定信息。模型预测存在歧视性披露现象：对于高质量企业，披露的发行价格与企业基本面呈正相关；而对于低质量企业，这种相关性则不复存在。基于中国股票市场在市场化注册制下的实证证据，利用独家来源的承销商内部定价报告中的IPO估值数据集，验证了这一理论预测。

abstract: Prospective merger simulations are a commonly used tool in industrial organization and antitrust, but evidence about their accuracy and predictive ability is limited. Despite the overprediction, we find that full merger simulations are more effective than both structural presumptions and approximations of the merger effect at identifying mergers with large price changes.

abstract: Standard intergenerational measures have been shown to understate the long-run persistence of socioeconomic advantages in developed countries. We study theoretically and empirically whether this pattern extends to less developed settings, using Indonesia as a case study. Using the Indonesian Family Life Survey (IFLS) and Census data, we study multigenerational correlations in education across three generations. Contrary to previous findings, we observe greater multigenerational mobility than parent-child correlations alone would suggest. We develop a theoretical framework to highlight two key factors influencing multigenerational dynamics in developing countries: (1) financial and credit constraints, and (2) cultural norms related to marital sorting. To confirm their relevance, we exploit regional variations in exposure to the 1997-98 Asian financial crisis and in marital customs.
abstract_zh: 标准代际衡量指标已被证明会低估发达国家社会经济优势的长期持续性。我们以印度尼西亚为案例，从理论和实证层面研究这一模式是否同样适用于欠发达地区。通过运用印度尼西亚家庭生活调查（IFLS）及人口普查数据，我们考察了横跨三代人的教育代际相关性。与既有研究发现相反，我们观察到三代人之间的代际流动性高于仅基于亲子两代关联性所呈现的水平。我们构建了一个理论框架，揭示影响发展中国家代际动态的两个关键因素：（1）金融与信贷约束；（2）与婚配选择相关的文化规范。为验证其相关性，我们利用各地区在1997-98年亚洲金融危机中的暴露程度差异以及婚俗差异进行实证分析。

abstract: Alternative care delivery models may offer benefits to patients and providers, but adoption often remains low. We study whether brief narrative testimonials shift willingness to attend virtual shared medical appointments (SMAs), a relatively little-used care format in which 5-15 patients with a shared non-urgent health condition meet simultaneously with a clinician. Using a pre-registered field experiment with over 4,000 women aged 45–60 in the UK, we randomly assigned participants to view only standard descriptive information about menopause appointment options (the control group) or to receive testimonials about SMAs from either previous patients or a clinician (treatment groups). Testimonials more than doubled the share of women choosing an SMA: when appointments were offered with a 6-8 week wait, 11% of the control group chose an SMA compared to 26% in the peer testimonials arm and 24% in the clinician testimonials arm. Shorter waiting times further increase uptake. When the SMA wait was reduced to one week, the share of women ever choosing an SMA rose by 14-19 percentage points across arms, reaching nearly 40% in the testimonial groups. Treatment effects are systematically larger among women with greater information-processing capacity: university education, higher baseline menopause knowledge, and broader information-seeking. Our findings suggest that women’s reluctance to choose SMAs is driven primarily by demand-side barriers, including unfamiliarity and uncertainty about their benefits, rather than deep-seated aversion to group-based care. Testimonials appear sufficient to meaningfully reduce these barriers.
abstract_zh: 替代性护理服务模式可能为患者和医疗服务提供者带来益处，但其采用率通常较低。我们研究了简短叙事性推荐能否提升患者参与虚拟共享医疗预约（SMA）的意愿——这是一种较少使用的护理形式，由5至15名患有相同非紧急健康问题的患者同时与临床医生会诊。通过对英国4500余名45至60岁女性进行预注册实地实验，我们随机将参与者分为仅查看更年期预约选项标准描述信息的对照组，以及接收来自既往患者或临床医生关于SMA推荐信息的处理组。推荐信息使选择SMA的女性比例提升一倍以上：当预约需等待6至8周时，对照组中11%的女性选择SMA，而同伴推荐组和临床医生推荐组分别达到26%和24%。缩短等待时间进一步提高了采用率。当SMA等待时间缩短至一周时，各组选择SMA的女性比例上升14至19个百分点，推荐组中该比例接近40%。处理效应在信息处理能力更强的女性中系统性更大：包括大学教育背景、更年期基线知识更丰富以及信息搜索范围更广的群体。我们的研究结果表明，女性不愿选择SMA主要源于需求侧障碍，包括对SMA益处的不熟悉和不确定性，而非对群体护理的深层抵触。推荐信息足以显著降低这些障碍。

title: Shaping Major Choice: The Role of High School Counselors

official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Existing studies show that high school counselors can significantly influence students' graduation rates and college enrollment; less is known about their ability to direct students toward particular fields of study. We evaluate an information intervention aimed at increasing counselors' awareness of economics, a major often associated with misconceptions about its content and career opportunities, and characterized by substantial under-representation of women and racial and ethnic minorities. Counselors from randomly selected Texas high schools were invited to participate in a one-day information workshop on the economics major. We evaluate the impact of the intervention on students' major preferences and outcomes using application and admissions data from a large public university attended by many graduates from the treatment schools, as well as enrollment and course-taking records from the Texas Education Research Center. The intervention led to substantial increases in interest in economics at the college application stage, particularly among high-achieving women, but did not lead to significant changes in college major outcomes. We conclude that high school counselors can play an important role in shaping students' field-of-study preferences, but translating preferences into enrollment requires additional exposure and reinforcement.
abstract_zh: 现有研究表明，高中辅导员能显著影响学生的毕业率和大学入学率，但关于他们引导学生选择特定学科领域的能力尚不明确。我们评估了一项信息干预措施，旨在提升辅导员对经济学专业的认知——该专业常因内容及职业前景存在误解，且女性及少数族裔群体代表性严重不足。来自德克萨斯州随机选取高中的辅导员受邀参加为期一天的经济学专业信息研讨会。我们利用一所大型公立大学的申请与录取数据（该校吸纳了大量干预学校毕业生）以及德克萨斯教育研究中心的入学与课程记录，评估该干预措施对学生专业偏好及学业成果的影响。干预措施显著提升了大学申请阶段学生对经济学的兴趣，尤其在高成就女性群体中效果明显，但并未导致大学专业选择结果发生显著变化。我们得出结论：高中辅导员在塑造学生学科领域偏好方面可发挥重要作用，但将偏好转化为实际入学仍需额外的接触与强化。

abstract: We study how Venezuelan refugee inflows affect healthcare outcomes and municipal public finances in Brazil's universal, decentralized public healthcare system. For identification, we exploit cross-municipality variation in refugee exposure and use distance to Brazil's only official border crossing with Venezuela as an instrument. A one-percentage-point increase in the local refugee share raises overall mortality by 4.2 percent and infant mortality by up to 9 percent. We show these effects operate through both the poorer baseline health of arriving refugees and congestion in local health facilities. Municipalities increase the share of spending on healthcare, but absent compensating federal transfers, they do so at the expense of education's budget share. These results highlight the limits of decentralized service provision in absorbing the health and fiscal costs of concentrated migration shocks.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了委内瑞拉难民涌入如何影响巴西全民、分权式公共医疗体系中的医疗结果与市政公共财政。为识别因果关系，我们利用各市难民暴露程度的差异，并以距离巴西唯一官方委内瑞拉边境口岸的距离作为工具变量。当地难民比例每增加一个百分点，总死亡率上升4.2%，婴儿死亡率最高上升9%。研究表明，这些影响既源于抵达难民较差的初始健康状况，也源于当地医疗设施的拥挤。各市增加了医疗支出占比，但在缺乏联邦转移支付补偿的情况下，这一调整以牺牲教育预算份额为代价。这些结果凸显了分权式服务供给在吸收集中性移民冲击带来的健康与财政成本方面的局限性。

title: The role of venture‐financed startups in innovation for US agriculture

official: 官方在线 2026-06-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: To evaluate the role played by startup companies in the innovation ecosystem of US agriculture, we compile a unique dataset of 6024 new entrants founded 1987–2019 that details their financing lifecycles, annual economic performance, and patenting activities. One‐third of the firms in the sample have observable signs of contributing to innovation, including patenting and external financing such as grants and venture capital, thus characterizing them as startups. Such startups and their financing have grown substantially over the period studied. We use discrete‐time survival analysis to test factors related to firms receiving venture financing as well as to firms achieving successful financial exits. We find those firms that file for patents have higher likelihood of receiving financing than those that do not. Patent filings also increase the relative probability of a successful financial exit, which takes place primarily through mergers and acquisitions. In about a third of such exits, startups are acquired by corporate incumbents in agriculture well positioned to scale up and commercialize those startups' innovations for US agriculture. Importantly, a substantial portion of firms in the sample are still too young to have attained venture financing let alone a financial exit.
abstract_zh: 为评估初创企业在美国农业创新生态系统中的作用，我们构建了一个包含1987-2019年间成立的6024家新企业的独特数据集，详细记录了其融资生命周期、年度经济绩效及专利活动。样本中三分之一的公司展现出可观测的创新贡献迹象，包括专利申请及获得赠款、风险投资等外部融资，从而被界定为初创企业。此类初创企业及其融资规模在研究期间显著增长。我们采用离散时间生存分析法，检验影响企业获得风险融资及实现成功财务退出的因素。研究发现，提交专利申请的企业获得融资的可能性高于未申请企业。专利申请同时提高了企业成功实现财务退出的相对概率，此类退出主要通过并购完成。在约三分之一的退出案例中，初创企业被农业领域具备规模化推广及商业化能力的现有企业收购，从而将其创新成果应用于美国农业。值得注意的是，样本中相当比例的企业仍处于发展初期，尚未获得风险融资，更遑论实现财务退出。

title: Geopolitical Rivalry Reshapes Global Innovation Networks
title_zh: 地缘政治竞争重塑全球创新网络

authors: Koski, Heli
official: 官方在线 2026-06-09 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Abstract Geopolitical tensions have increasingly extended to the development of strategic technologies. In particular, technological rivalry between the United States and China has reshaped firms’ international innovation networks and the organization of research and development activities. Patent data from leading 5G firms indicate that the effects of geopolitical fragmentation are strongest among firms whose innovation networks were previously highly integrated across geopolitical blocs. In these firms, the increase in geopolitical fragmentation is associated with a reduction of approximately 2.1 percentage points in the likelihood of collaboration between cross-block inventors, equivalent to roughly one quarter of the average level of collaboration. Geopolitical fragmentation also reduces inventor team diversity and the participation of inventors from rival geopolitical blocs. The effects were the broadest among Chinese firms. The findings suggest that geopolitical rivalry affects not only trade, investment, and technology transfer but also innovation networks through which new technologies are developed. In strategic industries such as 5G, geopolitical fragmentation may narrow the channels of international knowledge exchange and reshape the structure of global innovation networks.
abstract_zh: 摘要 地缘政治紧张局势已日益延伸至战略技术的发展领域。特别是，美国与中国之间的技术竞争重塑了企业的国际创新网络以及研发活动的组织方式。来自领先5G企业的专利数据表明，地缘政治碎片化的影响在那些此前创新网络高度跨地缘政治阵营整合的企业中最为显著。在这些企业中，地缘政治碎片化的加剧与跨阵营发明者之间合作可能性的降低约2.1个百分点相关，这相当于平均合作水平的约四分之一。地缘政治碎片化还降低了发明者团队的多样性以及来自对立地缘政治阵营发明者的参与度。这些影响在中国企业中最为广泛。研究结果表明，地缘政治竞争不仅影响贸易、投资和技术转让，还影响新技术开发的创新网络。在5G等战略产业中，地缘政治碎片化可能收窄国际知识交流的渠道，并重塑全球创新网络的结构。

title: Democratic backsliding as a Pigouvian political externality
title_zh: 民主倒退作为庇古式政治外部性
title_primary: 民主倒退作为庇古式政治外部性
title_secondary: Democratic backsliding as a Pigouvian political externality
authors: Thomas Barnebeck Andersen
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Liberal democracies increasingly curtail civil liberties in response to cultural tensions. I show that such repression can be conceived as a Pigouvian political externality: governments enjoy immediate political benefits from reduced social tension but systematically undervalue long-run costs of institutional erosion. The externality arises because finite tenure and reduced post-tenure valuation make politicians discount institutional quality more steeply than society. I formalize this mechanism in a dynamic linear-quadratic model in which repression lowers visible tension today while degrading future institutional quality, and I derive a closed-form “social cost of repression,” analogous to the social cost of carbon in environmental economics. Pigouvian logic, typically used to diagnose market failure, is here applied to a government failure in democratic self-regulation. I then characterize a class of market-based instruments—sovereign “democracy covenant” bonds, whose coupon rates rise automatically when civil-liberties indices deteriorate—that embed the shadow cost of repression into borrowing costs and thereby better align short-run political incentives with long-run democratic resilience.
abstract_zh: 自由民主政体在应对文化紧张局势时，日益限制公民自由。本文论证此类压制可被理解为一种庇古式政治外部性：政府从社会紧张局势缓解中即时获得政治收益，却系统性低估制度侵蚀的长期成本。这种外部性源于有限任期与离任后价值折损，导致政治家对制度质量的折现率高于社会整体。本文通过动态线性二次模型形式化该机制——压制行为在降低当前显性紧张的同时，持续削弱未来制度质量，并推导出类似环境经济学中"碳社会成本"的"压制社会成本"闭合解。通常用于诊断市场失灵的庇古逻辑，在此被应用于民主自我规制中的政府失灵。进而，本文刻画了一类市场型工具——主权"民主契约"债券，其票面利率随公民自由指数恶化自动攀升——通过将压制的影子成本内化至借贷成本，使短期政治激励与长期民主韧性实现更优校准。

abstract: Using unique contract‐level data from the Czech labor market, we investigate how monetary policy shocks, identified by the high‐frequency surprises in interest rate futures, affect the distribution of wages and hours worked. abstract_zh: 利用捷克劳动力市场中独特的合同级数据，我们研究了通过利率期货高频意外变动识别的货币政策冲击如何影响工资与工作时间的分布。与现有文献一致，我们的发现表明，低收入群体受这些冲击的影响大于高收入群体。创新之处在于我们探讨了不同人口统计特征和行业群体间的异质性效应。结果显示，年龄、教育程度、就业部门以及雇佣合同期限在工资和工作时间对政策冲击的反应中扮演重要角色。

abstract: We use administrative data to measure sibling spillovers on academic performance before and after the introduction of Free Secondary Education (FSE) in Tanzania. Prior to FSE, students whose older siblings narrowly passed the secondary school entrance exam were less likely to go to secondary school themselves; with FSE, the effect became positive. A triple-differences analysis, using geographic variation in FSE exposure, shows that FSE caused the reversal. Mechanism analyses suggest that changes in parental investments were a more likely channel for this reversal than direct sibling interactions. By alleviating financial constraints, FSE allowed households to invest in more children.
abstract_zh: 我们利用行政数据，衡量坦桑尼亚实施免费中等教育（FSE）前后，兄弟姐妹对学业表现的溢出效应。在FSE实施前，其兄姐以微弱优势通过中学入学考试的学生，自身升入中学的可能性反而更低；而FSE实施后，这一效应转为正向。通过利用FSE覆盖范围的地理差异进行三重差分分析，结果表明FSE导致了这一逆转。机制分析表明，相较于直接的兄弟姐妹互动，父母投资的变化更可能是这一逆转的传导渠道。通过缓解经济约束，FSE使家庭能够对更多子女进行教育投资。

abstract: ABSTRACT For most Southeast Asian nations, sustainable development remains a challenge. Despite environmental, technological, social and economic barriers, it is important to track sustainability progress in the region, given its agriculture‐based economy. This study aims to develop sustainability metric indicators for agricultural systems, examine the regional sustainability performance index and identify regional opportunities and challenges for achieving the Sustainable Development Goals. We used principal component analysis (PCA) to create new sustainability metrics for Southeast Asia. Data from the Asian Development Bank were used to determine the key dimensions of sustainability metrics. The analysis produced eight sustainability metrics based on component loadings: climate footprint, material‐use efficiency, agrifood system emissions, research and innovation, sustainable consumption and production of biofuels, information and communication technology (ICT), energy access and trade. Most agriculture‐based economies have high emissions from their agricultural systems and low material‐use efficiency. These challenges necessitate strategic development intervention, which aligns with the region's agricultural base. For example, agricultural trade can be expanded to include bio‐based products. This, coupled with the cross‐collaboration of bio‐based products in the region, will minimise agrifood emissions from countries with above‐average emissions, such as Indonesia. This study recommends the development of region‐specific monitoring frameworks to track progress in sustainability.
abstract_zh: 摘要 对于大多数东南亚国家而言，可持续发展仍是一项挑战。尽管面临环境、技术、社会和经济障碍，鉴于该地区以农业为基础的经济形态，追踪其可持续发展进展至关重要。本研究旨在为农业系统制定可持续性指标，评估区域可持续性绩效指数，并识别实现可持续发展目标的区域机遇与挑战。我们采用主成分分析（PCA）为东南亚创建新的可持续性度量指标。利用亚洲开发银行的数据来确定可持续性指标的关键维度。分析基于成分载荷生成了八项可持续性度量指标：气候足迹、材料使用效率、农业食品系统排放、研究与创新、生物燃料的可持续消费与生产、信息与通信技术（ICT）、能源获取及贸易。大多数以农业为基础的经济体在农业系统方面排放较高，而材料使用效率较低。这些挑战需要战略性发展干预，这与该地区的农业基础相契合。例如，农业贸易可扩展至包括生物基产品。结合该地区生物基产品的跨领域合作，这将有助于减少排放高于平均水平国家（如印度尼西亚）的农业食品排放。本研究建议开发针对特定区域的监测框架，以追踪可持续发展进展。

abstract: We develop and extend notions of potentials for normal-form games (Monderer and Shapley, 1996) to present a unified approach for the general class of social environments. The different potentials and corresponding social environments can be ordered in terms of their permissiveness. We classify different methods to construct potentials and we characterize potentials for specific examples such as matching problems, vote trading, multilateral trade, TU games, and various pillage games.

abstract: We find that Dutch disease effects on unemployment are small even in a commodity-rich economy like Australia. Using an estimated open-economy model with frictional unemployment, we quantify how business-cycle shocks and structural changes shape aggregate unemployment. A permanent rise in commodity prices in the 2000s appreciated the real exchange rate and temporarily increased unemployment, but its effect was offset by a gradual, secular decline in the disutility of work in the non-tradable sector, a key driver of long-run structural change. Shifting preferences toward non-tradables, together with non-commodity shocks, account for most of the observed unemployment dynamics.
abstract_zh: 我们发现，即便在像澳大利亚这样资源丰富的经济体中，荷兰病效应对失业的影响也较小。通过运用一个包含摩擦性失业的估计开放经济模型，我们量化了商业周期冲击与结构性变化如何共同塑造总体失业状况。2000年代大宗商品价格的永久性上涨导致实际汇率升值并暂时推高了失业率，但其影响被非贸易部门工作负效用逐渐且长期性的下降所抵消，这一下降是长期结构性变化的关键驱动力。偏好向非贸易品转移，加之非大宗商品冲击，解释了大部分观察到的失业动态变化。

abstract: Since ignorance can serve as an excuse for selfish behavior, people sometimes avoid learning about possible negative externalities of their actions. In social situations, however, others might provide the information anyway. How do potential informers affect willful ignorance and the resulting social outcomes? We introduce a third-party potential informer into the moral wiggle-room game. Almost half of the dictators avoided information only to have it imposed upon them by the informer. Most of these unwillingly-informed dictators revised their behavior to benefit the recipient, even at a cost to themselves. While knowledge of the informer’s presence did not change dictators’ propensity to seek information, a subtle change in the experimental choice interface did: The share of dictators choosing ignorance was more than halved when the dictator’s ignorance and allocation choices were made in two separate decision screens rather than a single one.
abstract_zh: 由于无知有时能为自私行为提供借口，人们有时会避免了解自身行为可能带来的负面外部效应。然而，在社交情境中，他人仍可能提供这些信息。潜在的信息提供者如何影响故意无知及其导致的社会结果？我们在道德模糊空间游戏中引入了第三方潜在信息提供者。近半数的独裁者选择回避信息，却不得不接受信息提供者强加的信息。这些非自愿获知信息的独裁者中，大多数调整了行为以惠及接收者，即便这需要他们自身承担成本。尽管知晓信息提供者的存在并未改变独裁者寻求信息的倾向，但实验选择界面的细微调整却产生了显著影响：当独裁者的无知与分配选择被置于两个独立的决策屏幕而非单一屏幕时，选择无知的独裁者比例减少了一半以上。

abstract: In a field experiment among US university students, incentives for sleep increase both sleep and academic performance. Our primary intervention pairs bedtime reminders with morning feedback and immediate rewards for sleeping at least 7 hours on weeknights. The intervention raises the share of weeknights with 7+ hours of sleep by 26% and average sleep by 19 minutes during a 4-week treatment period, with posttreatment effects of 8 minutes. Immediate incentives outperform both delayed incentives and reminders/feedback alone during treatment but have no distinguishable impacts posttreatment. The primary intervention improves average semester course performance by 0.075–0.089 grade points, a 0.10–0.11 standard deviation increase. Our results demonstrate that incentives targeting sleep can be a cost-effective approach to improve educational outcomes.
abstract_zh: 在一项针对美国大学生的实地实验中，睡眠激励措施同时提升了睡眠时长和学业表现。我们的主要干预措施结合了睡前提醒、晨间反馈以及针对工作日夜间至少睡眠7小时的即时奖励。该干预措施在为期4周的治疗期内，将工作日夜间达到7小时以上睡眠的比例提高了26%，平均睡眠时间增加了19分钟，治疗后的效果为8分钟。即时激励在治疗期间优于延迟激励及仅提供提醒/反馈的方式，但在治疗后的影响上无显著差异。主要干预措施使学期平均课程成绩提高了0.075至0.089个绩点，相当于0.10至0.11个标准差的提升。我们的结果表明，针对睡眠的激励措施可以成为改善教育成果的一种成本效益高的方法。

abstract: This paper examines the development and impact of macroprudential policies in the euro area. We construct a novel index that captures the stance of macroprudential policy, and we highlight its main stylized facts since the inception of the euro in 1999. We combine a narrative approach and a structural VAR method to show that both unanticipated or surprise shocks and anticipated or news shocks contribute over the medium and long term to safeguard financial stability. We also find significant linkages between monetary and macroprudential policies that enhance the policy mix.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了欧元区宏观审慎政策的发展及其影响。我们构建了一个新颖的指数来捕捉宏观审慎政策的立场，并强调了自1999年欧元诞生以来其主要典型事实。我们结合叙事方法和结构VAR方法，表明无论是未预期的或意外冲击，还是预期的或新闻冲击，在中长期内都有助于维护金融稳定。我们还发现货币政策和宏观审慎政策之间存在显著联系，这增强了政策组合的效果。

abstract: In the post-epidemic era, as China’s economy slows and the risk exposure of various sectors gradually increases, research on the risk contribution of sectors should be strengthened. This study introduces the TVM-MIDAS Copula-MES approach, which considers tail dependencies with asymmetric long memory when capturing the systemic risk contribution of Chinese sectors. We find that incorporating the asymmetric long memory feature of tail dependence can enhance the accuracy of both model fitting and measurement of systematic risk contribution. Furthermore, aside from the consumer sector, all other sectors show some degree of tail-dependent long memory. Compared to other sectors, real estate displays significant long memory in both upper and lower tail dependencies, while the materials and medical sectors exhibit the strongest long memory in upper and lower tail dependencies, respectively. Additionally, during the US subprime crisis, the Chinese financial sector contributed significantly more to systemic risk than other sectors, whereas during the Chinese stock market crash, its contribution was the opposite. Throughout the COVID-19 pandemic, the systemic risk contribution of all Chinese sectors remained relatively stable. Moreover, the Chinese utilities sector has the smallest systematic risk contribution overall, while the information technology sector shows the opposite trend.
abstract_zh: 后疫情时代，随着中国经济增速放缓及各行业风险敞口逐步增大，加强行业风险贡献研究显得尤为重要。本研究引入TVM-MIDAS Copula-MES方法，在捕捉中国行业系统性风险贡献时，考虑了具有非对称长记忆性的尾部依赖特征。研究发现，纳入尾部依赖的非对称长记忆特性能够提升模型拟合及系统性风险贡献度量的准确性。此外，除消费行业外，其他行业均表现出一定程度的尾部依赖长记忆性。与其他行业相比，房地产行业在上尾和下尾依赖中均展现出显著的长记忆性，而材料行业和医疗行业分别在上尾和下尾依赖中表现出最强的长记忆性。同时，在美国次贷危机期间，中国金融行业对系统性风险的贡献显著高于其他行业，而在中国股市崩盘期间，其贡献则呈现相反趋势。在整个COVID-19疫情期间，中国各行业的系统性风险贡献保持相对稳定。此外，中国公用事业行业的系统性风险贡献总体最小，而信息技术行业则呈现相反趋势。

abstract: This article investigates the impacts of monetary policy, macro- and micro-prudential supervision, and their coordination on mitigating systemic risk in China at both macro and micro levels. At the macro level, we employ the TVP-SV-SVAR model to capture the time-varying impacts of these policies on financial-real sector risk spillover. The results show that expansionary monetary policy and micro-prudential supervision increase the risk spillover, while macro-prudential supervision has the opposite effect. At the micro level, we use bank-level panel data to evaluate the individual and interactive effects of these policies on banks’ systemic risk-taking. The findings reveal that expansionary monetary policy increases banks’ systemic risk through the risk-taking channel, whereas both macro- and micro-prudential supervision reduce banks’ risk-taking. Most notably, the results highlight the significance of policy coordination. Macro-prudential supervision can mitigate the negative effects of expansionary monetary policy, while micro-prudential tools require strategic integration with macro-prudential supervision to reduce macro-level risk spillover.
abstract_zh: 本文从宏观与微观两个层面，考察了货币政策、宏观审慎监管、微观审慎监管及其协调配合对中国系统性风险的缓释效应。在宏观层面，我们采用TVP-SV-SVAR模型捕捉上述政策对金融-实体经济风险溢出的时变影响。结果表明，扩张性货币政策与微观审慎监管加剧了风险溢出，而宏观审慎监管则产生相反效果。在微观层面，我们利用银行层面面板数据评估了这些政策对银行系统性风险承担行为的独立效应与交互效应。研究发现，扩张性货币政策通过风险承担渠道增加了银行的系统性风险，而宏观与微观审慎监管均降低了银行的风险承担。尤为重要的是，研究结果凸显了政策协调的重要性：宏观审慎监管能够缓解扩张性货币政策的负面效应，而微观审慎工具需与宏观审慎监管进行战略整合，方能降低宏观层面的风险溢出。

title: Pareto-efficiency of ordinal multiwinner voting rules

abstract: We investigate the Pareto-efficiency of ordinal multiwinner voting rules, that is, voting rules based on ordinal preference profiles over candidates. Defining Pareto-optimality of a committee requires relating the voters’ rankings over individual candidates to their preferences over committees. We consider two well-known extension principles that extend rankings over candidates to preferences over committees: the responsive extension and the lexicographic extension. As the responsive extension outputs partial orders, we consider two Pareto-optimality notions: a committee is possibly (respectively, necessary) Pareto-optimal if it is Pareto-optimal for some (respectively, every) completion of these partial orders. As the lexicographic extension principle outputs a total order, it leads to only one Pareto-optimality notion. We then define several notions of Pareto-efficiency of multiwinner rules, depending on whether some (respectively, all) committees in the output are Pareto-optimal for one of the latter notions. We review what we believe to be a complete list of ordinal multiwinner rules that have been studied in the literature, and identify which Pareto-efficiency notions they satisfy. Our finding is that, somewhat surprisingly, these rules show a huge diversity: some satisfy the strongest notion, some do not even satisfy the weakest one, with many other rules at various intermediate levels.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了序数多赢家投票规则的帕累托效率，即基于候选人的序数偏好分布的投票规则。定义委员会的帕累托最优性需要将选民对单个候选人的排序与其对委员会的偏好联系起来。我们考虑两种广为人知的扩展原则，将候选人的排序扩展为对委员会的偏好：响应扩展和词典序扩展。由于响应扩展输出偏序，我们考虑两种帕累托最优性概念：一个委员会是可能（分别地，必然）帕累托最优的，如果它对于这些偏序的某些（分别地，所有）完备化是帕累托最优的。由于词典序扩展原则输出全序，它仅导致一种帕累托最优性概念。随后，我们根据输出中的某些（分别地，所有）委员会是否满足上述某种帕累托最优性概念，定义了多赢家规则的若干帕累托效率概念。我们回顾了文献中研究过的、我们认为完整的序数多赢家规则列表，并识别了它们满足哪些帕累托效率概念。我们的发现是，有些出人意料的是，这些规则表现出巨大的多样性：有些满足最强的概念，有些甚至不满足最弱的概念，而许多其他规则则处于各种中间水平。
